pics.alt: Black-and-white photograph of David Hilbert wearing a white hat and round glasses
pics.caption: David Hilbert (1862–1943). His Grundlagen der Geometrie (1899) gave Euclidean geometry a complete modern system of axioms.

pics.caption: Johannes Kepler's model of the solar system from Mysterium Cosmographicum (1596), which nests the five Platonic solids between the spheres of the six known planets.
